summary: Restore archived leads safely, enforce correction authorship, cancel outreach only and normalize API parser errors through a dedicated ingress with compatible SPA security policy.

api.reason: API 1.23.0 adds scoped optimistic restoration and correction authorship; Hosting parser errors are normalized before the managed provider.
api.permissions: Restore requires leads:edit/current scope and existing PAT leads:archive. Corrections require original actorUid or Admin plus current activity capability/lead scope.

metrics.reason: Ingress reuses bounded HTTP outcome/duration metrics with revision identity and finite parser error categories, without URL or identity dimensions.

traces.reason: Real ingress server/forwarding spans propagate SDK context to the fixed API backend; existing domain tracing remains authoritative.

logs.reason: Sanitized OTel completion/error and bounded platform outcomes exclude URLs/queries/headers/contacts/bodies; automatic ingress request access logs are excluded.

businessEvents.reason: Restoration adds one atomic restored lifecycle outcome, durable when the SDK is unavailable. Proxy rejections create no domain events.

deploymentEvents.reason: Actual ingress case receipts join existing lifecycle telemetry; build/revision/parser validation is a required deployment phase with separate metadata.

manualVerification: Review synthetic archive cards and confirmation at measured phone/desktop widths and shared breakpoints. Rehearse report-only then enforced CSP on a local build. Inspect live Google/RUM startup without customer sign-in. Verify Hosting malformed JSON/no-store/request/version and all five Functions plus ingress separately. Physical devices and tenant-query linkage remain separate unverified boundaries.
